notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
Ok, so for the past couple of months I have been working on the game trying to make more levels and stuff.

In this update:
[list]
[*] 168 new levels, 208 in total.
[*] They are now grouped by difficulty in 4 groups: Easy, Medium, Hard and Insane.
[*] Each group has 8 episodes (except for Insane, right now it only has 2)
[*] Each episode has 8 levels.
[*] When you finish all levels in each episode, you get an achievement and all the scores are summed up and you get ranked on the episode leaderboard. 
[*] When you finish all episodes in the group you also get ranked on the group leaderboard.
[*] 8 of the achievements are hidden and still not fully implemented. Will add them in the following days.
[*] And some other changes (bug fixes and stuff polishing) that I can't bother to remember
[*] Support for Linux + SteamOS
[*] [b]No levels were removed and no leaderboards were reset. Your progress is not lost.[/b]
[/list]

There may be bugs, because I rushed a bit to release the update, because I delayed it for too long. So if you discover any, please report them asap. Thanks in advance!

Peace ✌

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
In this update:
[list]
[*] Now physics runs at 100 times per second and the smallest score increment is 0.01 seconds. (Physics used to run at 50 times per second, so the smallest score increment was 0.02s) 
[*] Added features to the Settings Menu
[*] Level Menu redesign
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
With this update, the leaderboards are integrated right at the levels menu.

Next thing to do is add more levels and figure out a better way to group them

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Two notable things in this update:
[olist]
[*]There is now exit confirmation dialog, and you can press ESC in the home screen to exit the game.
[*]The home screen level (level 0) is changed a bit. In the beginning, the platform path span is more narrow and it gradually increases until platform 50. This way it should be easier for beginners to learn the game mechanics and score some points. (Your feedback is welcome)
[/olist]
Hopefully, more bugs were fixed than created.  ːsteamfacepalmː
